locked.running: Options are locked while a download runs.
locked.loading: Options are locked while the series loads.

readingDirection.label: Reading direction
readingDirection.hint: Which way the pages turn: manga reads right to left, western comics left to right.

packHint.parts: One file per chapter, with its parts merged into it. Chapters without parts get a file each as usual.
packHint.volumes: One file per volume, set above the chapter list. Chapters outside every volume get a file each.
packHint.volumesNotLoaded: One file per volume, set above the chapter list (when loaded). Chapters outside every volume get a file each.
packHint.bundle: The selected chapters in a single file.

pages.title: Pages
pages.convertHint: Most e-readers can't open AVIF; WebP is unreliable on e-ink.
pages.avifEpub: Always on for EPUB: readers can't show AVIF.

compress.label: Compress pages
compress.hint: Saves pages as JPEG when that makes them smaller. JPEG pages only shrink at a lower JPEG quality, set under Advanced.

quality.label: JPEG quality
quality.hint: From 1 to 100: used for every page saved as JPEG, by Convert to JPEG or Compress pages. Lower means smaller files.
quality.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.

skipPages.label: Skip pages
skipPages.hint: Positions dropped from every chapter: {{first}} is the second page, {{last}} the last.

template.label: Filename template
template.hint: Uses {{series}}, {{number}}, {{title}}, {{siteTitle}}, {{group}}, {{volume}} and {{version}}; {{padded}} zero-pads a number. Left as is, volumes are named {{volumeName}}, or {{volumeGroupName}} when their chapters share a group.

browser.label: Show the browser window
browser.hint: Rarely needed: the window opens by itself when a site asks for it.
browser.auto: Needed for this site: the window opens by itself.
